title: Valid GitHub Actions context and bounded bootstrap for protected Production promotion evidence

phases.objective: Allow GitHub to register and plan the Production-target generated-artifact evidence workflow, permit only its exact three-file read-only contract bootstrap, and preserve full generated-artifact evaluation for every wider promotion.

e2e_journeys.actor: release operator and GitHub Actions workflow planner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request is opened, synchronized, or reopened with base Production
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub schedules Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh on the exact PR head and selects either the exact three-file contract-bootstrap path or the full generated-artifact evaluation without repository mutation.
steps: Reject jobs-level use of runner.temp before a runner exists.
Bind exact source head, source branch, Production base ref, and Production base SHA from the pull-request event.
Checkout the exact same-repository head without persisted credentials.
Diff the exact base SHA against HEAD and compare the sorted changed-file set with the fixed three-file bootstrap allowlist.
When and only when the sets match exactly, execute the focused context regression and publish canonical outcome=passed with mode=contract_bootstrap.
For every wider or different change set, run the full generated-artifact evaluator from repository root.
Upload the canonical JSON and Markdown reports from stable repository-relative paths and enforce mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1.
assertions: REPORT_PATH and REPORT_MARKDOWN_PATH are stable repository-relative paths.
PR_BASE_SHA is sourced from github.event.pull_request.base.sha and validated as a commit.
Bootstrap mode requires exact file-set equality and exact cardinality for the workflow, focused regression, and this E2E contract.
Bootstrap mode does not depend on branch names, labels, actor names, or free-form inputs.
The bounded bootstrap canonical report declares mode=contract_bootstrap, outcome=passed, repository_mutation_performed=false, and secrets_included=false.
Every non-bootstrap change runs the full generated-artifact evaluator from repository root.
The workflow remains pull_request-only for base Production and rejects a Production head.
Permissions remain contents:read with persist-credentials:false and no contents:write.
Exact local and remote source-head identity remains enforced.
No migration, deployment, Production mutation, provider call, credential access, external publication, direct contents write, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe an exact three-file Production bootstrap publish passed mode=contract_bootstrap evidence, then observe a wider exact-head release candidate execute and pass the full generated-artifact evaluation.

Exercise one missing allowlisted file, one extra file, a renamed branch, stale source or base SHA, cross-repository heads, blocked generated drift, missing reports, and publisher failure without consulting Job logs.
This repository automation repair performs no live provider or deployment canary.
The workflow grants no migration, runtime, provider, credential, deployment, or direct Production mutation authority.
